pairsWith.noteUz: Grammar 11-12-unitlar: 2-tur shart gap, nisbiy olmoshlar (who/which/where), some/any/no birikmalari, joy predloglari (in/on/at).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, PROGRESS TEST 6 - Units 11-12 (89-bet, PDF 82). Sarlavha 'PROGRESS TEST 6 | Units 11-12'. Ramka: NAME / DATE / CLASS / MARK, '(Time: 20 minutes)'. Chap chetda qaychi belgisi.

'Choose the correct item.'
1 If Sue ... the lottery, she would buy a house near the sea. A wins B won C will win. 2 I've got ... money in my wallet. A any B not any C no. 3 A theatre is a place ... you can watch a performance. A where B which C who. 4 Boston is located ... the east coast of the United States of America. A on B in C at. 5 If people stopped dropping litter on the streets, our cities ... much cleaner. A be B would be C have been. 6 A doctor is someone ... treats sick people. A where B which C who. 7 There is ... sugar in the cupboard. A any B a few C some. 8 Paraguay is ... the heart of South America. A at B in C on. 9 If I ... you, I would take up guitar lessons. A were B was C am. 10 Tony wants to go on holiday ... in the Caribbean Sea. A something B somewhere C someone.
11 If Bob ... up earlier, he would arrive at work on time. A wakes B woke C was waking. 12 A toothbrush is something ... you clean your teeth with. A where B which C who. 13 Marseille is situated ... the south of France. A at B on C in. 14 A lawn mower is something ... cuts grass. A where B which C who. 15 If Lucy ... so many sweets, she wouldn't be overweight. A won't eat B doesn't eat C didn't eat. 16 A coach is someone ... trains athletes. A who B which C where. 17 A: Who's in the kitchen? B: ... . A Anybody B Nobody C Anything. 18 Has ... called me today? A someone B anyone C no one. 19 A garage is a place ... you can park your car. A where B which C who. 20 There aren't ... cookies in the cookie jar. A some B no C any.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '89'.

exercises.explanationUz:
11-12-UNITLAR TESTI - 20 savol.

  2-TUR ShART (If + past, would):
    1 If Sue WON, 5 cities WOULD BE,
    9 If I WERE you, 11 If Bob WOKE
    up, 15 If Lucy DIDN'T EAT
  NISBIY OLMOSh: 3 a place WHERE,
    6 someone WHO, 12 something
    WHICH, 14 something WHICH, 16
    someone WHO, 19 a place WHERE
  SOME / ANY / NO: 2 I've got NO
    money, 7 There is SOME sugar,
    10 SOMEWHERE, 17 NOBODY (kim?
    - hech kim), 18 Has ANYONE
    called? (savol), 20 aren't ANY
    cookies
  PREDLOG: 4 ON the east coast, 8
    IN the heart of, 13 IN the
    south of France

  ⚠ ON the coast, IN the south, IN
  the heart.


⚠ 'LAWN MOWER':

  = maysa o'rgich.

patterns.formula: If + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON, EGA + would + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If Sue won the lottery, she would buy a house near the sea.
patterns.exampleUz: Syu lotereyada yutganida, dengiz yonidan uy sotib olardi.

patterns.formula: OT + is + a place where / someone who / something which + ...
patterns.exampleEn: A theatre is a place where you can watch a performance. A coach is someone who trains athletes.
patterns.exampleUz: Teatr - tomosha ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan joy. Murabbiy - sportchilarni mashq qildiradigan odam.

patterns.formula: JOY + is located / situated + on the coast / in the south / in the heart of
patterns.exampleEn: Boston is located on the east coast. Marseille is situated in the south of France.
patterns.exampleUz: Boston sharqiy qirg'oqda joylashgan. Marsel Fransiyaning janubida joylashgan.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ SOME / ANY / NO + BODY / THING / WHERE
